title: Fire Resisting Computer Media Protection Cabinets Specification
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the requirements regarding materials, sizes, details of construction, testing procedure and performance criteria of fire resisting computer media protection cabinets which afford security to computer media such as floppy disks, compact disks, USB drives, SD cards, portable hard disc, etc, against fire.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Guide for drafting and presentation of Indian Standards
